messages:
maria_support: Heads-up 1: ACME support ticket wants streaming tool/function call events + a final validated JSON envelope for downstream ingestion. They need partial tool-call progress so UI can show live progress, and server-side schema validation for the final payload.

sam_support: pasted ticket snippet: 'Large responses break our pipeline. We need tool_call_start/tool_call_chunk/tool_call_end events and then a final_structured object that adheres to our schema. If final payload fails validation we want an error code so our system can retry.'

alex_engineer: clarification: event frames vs token stream? We currently stream tokens. Adding explicit lifecycle events is doable but needs framing changes + SDK updates. Any SLOs?

maria_support: customer provided example frames (tool_call_start/chunk/end/final_structured). They expect sequence numbers and a trace_id to reconcile logs.

jason_product: ask to sales: Kai, how urgent relative to ACME deal?

kai_sales: ACME ~120k ARR, evaluating Dedicated next quarter. This is a strong ask for them; moving fast could materially affect close timing. Recommend spike now.

alex_engineer: rough plan: 1) 2w spike for wire format & perf tests; 2) 4w runtime + validation impl; 3) 1w SDK changes; 4) 1w canary. Opt-in API flag (stream_events=true) + named schema param. Server-side validation opt-in per customer.

jason_product: draft acceptance criteria: documented event model, SDK examples, backwards compatibility for non-streaming clients, perf regression under threshold, canary & rollback plan.

maria_support: I'll collect 2-3 more customer examples and the customer's schema file. ETA 3 business days.

alex_engineer: will open spike ticket and add an initial sketch of SSE-style frames with type, seq, trace_id, payload. Include example: data: {"type":"tool_call_chunk","seq":3,"trace_id":"t-123","chunk":"..."}

deploybot: new ticket INF-8703 created by alex_engineer 1: https://go.redwood.ai/INF-8703

jason_product: decision: start spike (P1 for ACME-driven backlog). Reassess after spike for wider roadmap. I'll prepare the acceptance card and link sales notes.

action items: maria_support collect samples; alex_engineer start spike doc in 2 days; jason_product write acceptance criteria; kai_sales set expectations with ACME. Marking thread triaged. :thumbsup:
